# First confirmed hit on a Saudi Red Sea port in this round, Wed Nov 25

| Object | State | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| **Jazan Port** | **HIT**, minor damage, no civilian casualties; projectile type under investigation | Coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki on X, CONFIRMED by a named authority; read through relays (Anadolu, Gulf News, Times of Israel, Shafaq; FALCON also MEE 17:00Z, AFP 21:39Z, Arab News, Xinhua). Post on X not read directly. **Clock time NOT ESTABLISHED** (FALCON infers after 05:00Z 11/25) |
| Jeddah Islamic Port | drone **INTERCEPTED**, no damage (coalition); Houthi 'precise hit' **CLAIM ONLY** | FALCON |
| Yanbu, Rabigh, King Abdullah Port | NOT FOUND | FALCON |
| Hodeidah | one coalition strike counted (coalition's claim); later strikes REPORTED by Houthi outlets only; damage NOT FOUND | FALCON |
| Carrier, Mawani, Aramco notice | NOT FOUND; ukmto.org and seatrade 403 | FALCON |

**Guards applied (IRAN_WAR_GUARDS):** Jazan PORT is not the Jazan refinery: do not merge with the 2025 to 2026 Aramco Jazan strikes or the 2019 Abqaiq trap. Jeddah was intercepted: 'intercepted' must not become 'struck' in the retelling. All relays trace to one statement: syndication is not corroboration. A port is outside FALCON's production rung.

**FALCON (owner) graded:** FAL-13 RESOLVED CONFIRMED (registered 25%); marks B 1 / C 14 / D 85 held; production rung NOT FIRED; GATE-FALCON-001 override not triggered (no ship attacked, no restriction executed). FALCON's forward view (unscored): another launch or claim at a Saudi Red Sea port in 72 h about 65%, another damaging hit about 20%; two weeks: damaging hit 45%, state-stated loading cut at Yanbu, Jeddah or Rabigh 10%, carrier Jeddah notice 25%. Why: the Houthis state a 'port for port' rule tied to each coalition strike on Hodeidah.

- **So what:** the threat of 11/20 (card 20261124-006) became one executed, minor hit. No oil export or barrel loss is found; Yanbu (about 2.7 mb/d in November, Kpler) is the asset that would matter. BRENT runs a bounded session now (PROME) on BRT-32 / BG-02; FALCON packeted BRENT and TERRY. Brent January BZF27 $94.60 at 19:56 ET (FALCON vendor read, evening trade, not a settle).
- **Anchor:** anchor_unverified_as_of 2026-11-23 (last full sweep); this hit is a state change for the 11/30 sweep.
